mapper.select: SELECT id, enabled, allowed_groups, allowed_users, platform_groups, require_mention, command_prefix, max_reply_length, memory_window, updated_at FROM bot_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bot_settings ( id, enabled, allowed_groups, allowed_users, platform_groups, require_mention, command_prefix, max_reply_length, memory_window, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{enabled}, #{allowedGroups}, #{allowedUsers}, #{platformGroups}, #{requireMention}, #{commandPrefix}, #{maxReplyLength}, #{memoryWindow}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, allowed_groups = EXCLUDED.allowed_groups, allowed_users = EXCLUDED.allowed_users, platform_groups = EXCLUDED.platform_groups, require_mention = EXCLUDED.require_mention, command_prefix = EXCLUDED.command_prefix, max_reply_length = EXCLUDED.max_reply_length, memory_window = EXCLUDED.memory_window, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
